title: A record's claim about what a tool reads or costs cites the code line that states it
why: Incident 15:00 CST Nov 7, lane pr-state-is-on-the-pr: a record-writer added "the ledger reads no CI state" to decision pr-ledger (#1419), while the code on that branch reads main's latest CI run. Caught by reading; no check compares a record's claim about a tool's reads with the tool's code.
note: Candidate: each record that claims a tool's reads or cost cites the docstring line that states it, as fresh-prose binds claims to checks. Done step prose-governance-workflow bound prose to code in general; this is the gap it left for read and cost claims. Coordinator to judge scope: fold into the fresh-prose skill or a lint. Coordinator scope, 15:05 CST: it goes into the fresh-prose skill and its existing record check, not a new lint. A record sentence about what code does cites the code symbol; the check confirms the symbol exists; the reviewer checks the sentence is true.
